beginner.title: Get started with Interactive Petrophysics
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Interactive Petrophysics, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Projects and data
beginner.outcome: You can: load and QC subsurface data
beginner.practice: Load and QC a sample dataset

beginner.title: Core interpretation
beginner.outcome: You can: complete the core workflow in Interactive Petrophysics

intermediate.title: Build the model
intermediate.outcome: You can: build a model fit for decisions
intermediate.practice: Build a simple model from your interpretation

intermediate.title: Uncertainty and scenarios
intermediate.outcome: You can: quantify what you don't know

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Interactive Petrophysics
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Interactive Petrophysics distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Interactive Petrophysics
expert.outcome: You can: use Interactive Petrophysics's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Integrate and report
expert.outcome: You can: hand over results to engineering and management

expert.title: Integrate Interactive Petrophysics into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Interactive Petrophysics with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Interactive Petrophysics to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Interactive Petrophysics well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Interactive Petrophysics" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
